```{r}
due <- get_schedule() %>%
  filter(n_assign == params$number) %>%
  pull(due_assign) %>%

```

> **Due**: `r due`
>
> **Grading**: Graded 0 / 0.5 / 1 using the
> [build rubric](../syllabus.qmd#build-rubric). Together, the builds are worth
> 25% of your final grade (lowest build dropped).
>
> **Purpose**: `r params$purpose`
>
> **Deliverable**: A GitHub repository with your build and the **transcript** of
> your work with the AI (your prompts, its responses, and your iterations). From
> Build 5 on, also include a **token usage report**. Make every commit yourself
> in GitHub Desktop: never let the agent commit for you. Scrub API keys and
> personal data from transcripts before submitting.
